Header of an R serialization file

Source: R/rds_info.R
rds_info.Rd

Reads the header of a file written by saveRDS(), save() or serialize(), or of a lazy-load database's index, without reading the object it holds.

Usage

rds_info(x, kind = NULL)

Arguments

x

A path, a raw vector (a serialize() result, or a file's bytes) or a connection open for reading in binary mode. For a lazy-load database, the path without extension, as lazyLoad() takes it, or the path of its .rdb or .rdx file.

kind

NULL to detect the kind of file, or one of "rds", "rda" and "lazyload" to insist on it.

Value

A list of class rds_info with elements:

  • kind: "rds" (a single stream, as saveRDS() and serialize() write), "rda" (as save() writes) or "lazyload".

  • format: "xdr", "binary" or "ascii".

  • version: the serialization format version, 2 or 3.

  • writer_version: the version of R that wrote the stream, as "4.6.1".

  • min_reader_version: the oldest version of R that can read it.

  • native_encoding: the writer's native encoding (version 3 only; NA for version 2).

  • compression: "none", "gzip", "bzip2", "xz" or "zstd"; NA for a connection, whose compression zurds does not see. For a lazy-load database, that of its index.

See also

Other inspection: rds_str(), rds_toc()

Examples

f <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
saveRDS(mtcars, f)
rds_info(f)
#> <rds_info>
#> kind:               rds
#> format:             xdr, version 3
#> written by R:       4.6.1
#> readable from R:    3.5.0
#> native encoding:    UTF-8
#> compression:        gzip

rds_info(serialize(1:3, NULL, version = 2))
#> <rds_info>
#> kind:               rds
#> format:             xdr, version 2
#> written by R:       4.6.1
#> readable from R:    2.3.0
#> native encoding:    NA
#> compression:        none
